Single Right-pointing Angle Quotation Mark Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Single Right-pointing Angle Quotation Mark is 0155. Hold Alt, type 0155 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Single Right-pointing Angle Quotation Mark also has the Unicode codepoint U+203A, so you can type it with Alt+8250 on Windows, search for U+203A in macOS's Character Viewer, use › in HTML, or \203A in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. On a US Mac keyboard, press ⌥⇧4 for Single Right-pointing Angle Quotation Mark; shortcuts can differ on other layouts. HTML also defines the named entity › for Single Right-pointing Angle Quotation Mark, but the numeric form › is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type single right-pointing angle quotation mark on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 0 1 5 5 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Single Right-pointing Angle Quotation Mark character (›) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type single right-pointing angle quotation mark on macOS

On a US keyboard layout, press ⌥⇧4 to insert Single Right-pointing Angle Quotation Mark. This shortcut assumes a US layout; other layouts may remap it.

If the shortcut does not work on your layout, open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Single Right-Pointing Angle Quotation Mark" and click the character.

How to use single right-pointing angle quotation mark in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\203A"; ()
  • Python: \u203A or chr(0x203A)
  • JavaScript: \u203A or String.fromCodePoint(0x203A)
  • JSON: "\u203A"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Single Right-pointing Angle Quotation Mark?

The legacy Alt code for Single Right-pointing Angle Quotation Mark is 0155. Hold Alt, type 0 1 5 5 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type › without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ›, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+8250 not work?

Alt+8250 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Single Right-pointing Angle Quotation Mark?

The Unicode codepoint for Single Right-pointing Angle Quotation Mark is U+203A. You can use this value in HTML as ›, in CSS as \203A, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type › on a Mac?

On a US Mac keyboard, press ⌥⇧4. If that does not work on your layout, open ⌃⌘Space and search for U+203A.
